name: Tyler Hoffman
action: Tyler shifts the phone to his other ear, rubs the back of his neck, and glances at the open workbook on the break-room table before letting out a short exhale. 'Yeah, I can come,' he says, trying to sound more certain than he feels. 'I'll bring a bag of ice. Sunday's my night off anyway, so there's no reason I can't.'
reason: Tyler felt mentally sluggish after four hours into his shift, but his mother's expectant pause on the phone cut through that and signaled that a noncommittal answer wouldn't be accepted. Aware of his pattern of skipping family dinners and showing up with only shredded cheese at Thanksgiving, he contrasted his own behavior with his father's consistency in bringing full dishes and Roy's disciplined daily exercises, which he genuinely respects. He reasoned that since Sunday was his night off and he had no conflicting plans, there was no reason not to go, and he decided that bringing a bag of ice would be an easy, low-commitment contribution that wouldn't make a fuss. He agreed to come, trying to sound more certain than he felt, reflecting his underlying ambivalence about whether he will actually follow through.
